theorems.name: Submission.tdo_slb_lintegral_rpow_le_scaledLpNorm
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p q : ℝ) (z w : Amb n ℓ) (s t m : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ p → 0 < t → 0 ≤ m → closedBall z s ⊆ closedBall w t → V.weight (closedBall z s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal m → ∫⁻ x in closedBall z s, ‖H x‖ₑ ^ q ∂V.weight ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (m ^ (1 - q / p) * t ^ (q * (n - p) / p)) * V.scaledLpNorm H p w t ^ q
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
